REQ-1.description: While an amendment is open, the amending plan revision is refused before any review round when a checkpoint lacks a well-formed anchor pair: at publish and bind, and at plan-stage bundle generation, with the same named error as approval and one next step; the approval-time check is unchanged

REQ-2.description: Every new plan revision of a two-stage work item carries a well-formed anchor pair around every checkpoint: /milestone-plan says so, and the same check refuses a revision without them at publish, bind and plan-stage bundle generation

REQ-3.description: In-flight work is not broken: a plan approved without anchors keeps driving implementation, reviews and acceptance until its next plan revision, a plan review bound before the update survives an unchanged regeneration of its bundle, and version-1 items are unchanged

REQ-4.description: An amendment that only adds a checkpoint keeps the other checkpoints COMPLETE when both plans carry anchors

REQ-5.description: The rule, the refusal and its next step, the downgrade posture and the unchanged protocol are written down, with a common-problems entry
